summary_en: SOFT99 Corporation will cancel 679,544 treasury shares, representing 3.1% of issued shares before cancellation. The cancellation is scheduled for December 18, 2026, conditional upon shareholder approval of a concurrent stock consolidation effective December 21, 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares will total 21,595,144.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On September 11, 2026, SOFT99 Corporation's board of directors resolved to cancel 679,544 treasury shares held by the company, based on Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares represent 3.1% of issued shares outstanding before cancellation. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on December 18, 2026, and will reduce issued shares to 21,595,144.

The cancellation is conditional on shareholder approval of a concurrent stock consolidation at an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for November 26, 2026, with the consolidation effective December 21, 2026. Upon completion, the company will hold zero treasury shares.
